ideas.title: Investigating Federal Agencies' Use of Force
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of force by federal agencies, including ICE and the FBI, and examine the transparency and accountability measures in place.
questions: What are the protocols in place for the use of force by federal agencies?
How are incidents of excessive use of force investigated and addressed?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a critical issue and hold federal agencies accountable for their actions.
